findings.title: Unsubmitted rental application drafts disclose PII to listing owner
findings.evidence: hostInbox filters only listingOwnerId; canView admits listingOwnerId regardless status/submittedAt; presenter spreads all persisted fields. lib/rental-applications.ts:81 tells users DRAFT materials are not submitted to landlord.
findings.preconditions: Authenticated listing owner; another renter has created a server-side DRAFT (including failed-submit recovery, or a withdrawn never-submitted draft).
findings.impact: Host GET /applications/host-inbox and GET /applications/:id return contact name/email, income band, guarantor status, occupation, note and member snapshots before submission.
findings.reproduction: Pinned pnpm 9.15.4, host Node 25, source-import probe /tmp/sublet-round2-security-probe.cjs confirmed hostInbox and findOne return DRAFT PII with submittedAt null.
findings.fix: Gate host reads on persisted submittedAt != null (rather than merely status != DRAFT, since never-submitted withdrawals also exist); keep submitter/team draft access. Add authorization regressions for DRAFT and WITHDRAWN with submittedAt null, and retain host access to submitted historical decisions.

findings.title: Viewing changes bypass message quota and grow unbounded thread history
findings.evidence: sendMessage consumes quota at line143, but each createViewingRequest call updates/creates a request and unconditionally inserts a dealMessage without invoking limiter. Every response and inbox query includes entire message history.
findings.preconditions: One authenticated renter with a conversation for an approved listing; no host acceptance or mutual match required.
findings.impact: Attacker can POST viewing changes repeatedly to flood the host inbox, bypass 20/min message limit, persist unlimited messages, and amplify future response memory/DB/browser work as history grows.
findings.reproduction: Pinned pnpm 9.15.4 source-import probe with limiter always throwing: 100 identical createViewingRequest calls succeeded, limiter calls0, messages100, final response messages100.
findings.fix: Consume shared deal conversation quota before every new viewing mutation that writes a message; make exact replay idempotent/no-op. Bound or paginate deal message history and viewing history in listing/read/write responses.

findings.title: Authentication rate-limit dependency waits have no deadline
findings.evidence: ValkeyRateLimitStore directly awaits client.connect() and client.eval() without a deadline or invalidation; driver uses default reconnect strategy and no socketTimeout. Authentication fails closed only after rejection, so hung operations never reach HTTP503.
findings.preconditions: Valkey or its network path accepts connections but stops replying, or a command stalls. An unauthenticated attacker can then repeatedly POST valid-shaped email-code/verify-email requests; frontend cancellation does not cancel the awaited dependency work.
findings.impact: Login verification becomes indefinitely unavailable and retained unauthenticated requests amplify API memory/socket exhaustion during dependency degradation.
findings.reproduction: /tmp/sublet-round2-auth-blackhole-probe.cjs uses the actual installed Redis5.12.1 client with a localhost TCP server consuming Redis handshake bytes without replying. Pinned pnpm9.15.4/Node25 AuthRateLimiter operation still pending after6203ms; source confirms no total deadline. Local server/client destroyed in cleanup; no external traffic.
findings.fix: Bound connect and eval waits, invalidate/destroy timed-out client so queued work is rejected, map timeout to existing production503, allow bounded reconnection/recovery. Reuse the bounded operation/invalidation approach already present in roommate-message-rate-limit.ts. Add stalled handshake and stalled EVAL tests.

findings.title: Archived roommate member preferences remain publicly enumerable through raw profile endpoint
findings.preconditions: An owned roommate profile created through the marketplace has been archived by an authenticated administrator. Any visitor can enumerate the unauthenticated raw profile collection.
findings.evidence: Create/update write RoommateMatchingProfile plus RoommateProfile; admin archive hides only RoommateProfile. GET /roommate-profiles filters only raw matching status active, without enforcing owned public projection visibility.
findings.impact: Archived member intro, budgets, date preferences and lifestyle details remain publicly returned even though the public roommate deck removes the member.
findings.reproduction: Pinned pnpm9.15.4 source-import probe /tmp/sublet-round2-profile-archive-probe.cjs: owned hidden, public deck0, raw public rows1 with intro unchanged.
findings.fix: Make all public roommate surfaces enforce the same persisted visibility boundary; synchronize archive to associated matching rows or filter raw public profiles against the visible owned projection. Test both public endpoints after archive.
